properties.name: A server holding many designs reports its open files against its limit, so the shortfall shows before a design is refused
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-28: "Go with your recommendation" (option F of the open question on the three limits)
properties.statement: A server that holds many designs reports how many files it has open and its open-file limit on its readiness check, so the shortfall shows before a design is refused and whoever hosts it can be alerted on it.
